approval.by: carried over from the copied-in Forge

outcome: The two biggest functions in the runtime are now readable one phase at a time. The job run loop (runActiveJob, 733 lines in one body) and the SDK query loop (runQuery, ~600 lines) each became a short sequencer over one context object, with every phase a named function in sibling modules — setup/lease/agent/finalization for jobs, options/setup and one handler per message kind for the query loop. Nothing changed in behaviour: every existing unit and Postgres integration test passes untouched. Complexity on the AST counter: sequencers under 15, largest phase under 25 (ceilings 15/25).
title: Job runner: split runActiveJob and runQuery by phase
